name: Dayang Enterprise Holdings Bhd
overview: 2026年，Dayang Enterprise Holdings Bhd 通过其全资子公司 DESB Marine Services Sdn Bhd 签订合同，以1.177亿令吉建造并购买一艘91米维护/工作船，扩大了其 Marine Offshore Support Services 板块的船队。公司未公告其他业务板块的扩张、缩减或退出。
overview_en: In 2026, Dayang Enterprise Holdings Bhd, through its wholly-owned subsidiary DESB Marine Services Sdn Bhd, entered into a contract to construct and purchase a 91-metre maintenance/work vessel for RM117.7 million, expanding its Marine Offshore Support Services segment fleet. No other business segment expansions, reductions, or exits were announced.

segments.name: 海事离岸支持服务
segments.note: 今年该板块通过子公司订造一艘91米维护/工作船，以扩大船队。
segments.note_en: This year, the segment expanded its fleet through a subsidiary's order for a 91-metre maintenance/work vessel.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 DESB Marine Services Sdn Bhd 与 Shin Yang Shipyard Sdn. Bhd. 签订买卖协议，以1.177亿令吉（不含销售与服务税）建造并购买一艘91米维护/工作船。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary DESB Marine Services Sdn Bhd entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Shin Yang Shipyard Sdn. Bhd. to construct and purchase a 91-metre maintenance/work vessel for RM117.7 million (excluding sales and service tax).
